name: Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd.
business_summary: Banking-software company (FLEXCUBE, OBP, Financial Crime and Compliance, analytics) majority owned (~72-73% by model knowledge) by Oracle Corp. Revenue lumpy because of upfront product licence recognition: Jun-26 quarter Rs3,125 cr / PAT Rs1,416 cr vs Sep-26 Rs1,907 cr / PAT Rs702 cr (+29% YoY per press). EBITDA margin 42-60%, ROE 32.6%, yield 3.9%, debt-free. Q2 FY27 reported 2026-10-23 with new leadership appointments formalised. Stock hit by Oracle parent concerns in Sept 2026.

exposures.mechanism: ~75% of revenue from outside India (model knowledge), INR costs ~ 55%. +3% => revenue +2.2%, cost +0.7% on costs ~ 50% of revenue... net +1.3% of revenue / 49% margin = +2.7% EBITDA, persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 0.95 => +1.3, shaded to +1.5. Pack +2.65 (t +1.1) agrees in sign.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 1,907 cr, OPM 49%, PAT 702 cr; Jun-26 qtr sales 3,125 cr, PAT 1,416 cr (licence spike)

exposures.mechanism: Americas ~ 40% of revenue, Asia-Pacific ~ 25%, EMEA ~ 30% (model knowledge). Product licences depend on bank IT budgets; +1pp US growth => revenue +0.5%; high incremental margin (70%) vs 49% => EBITDA +0.7%; plus multiple effect => ~+1.5. Pack S&P +2.96 (t +2.4) shows a high US-sentiment beta for the stock.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 1,907 cr, OPM 49%, PAT 702 cr; Jun-26 qtr sales 3,125 cr, PAT 1,416 cr (licence spike)

exposures.mechanism: Product firm with banking-platform moat (FLEXCUBE); GenAI affects services (~20-25% of revenue) more than licences/cloud. 3% repricing of services x 80% / 49% => -1% EBITDA... plus perception effect on product pricing; persistence 0.5 => ~-2, wide range.
